description: David's wandering life brings increasingly personal encounters with family, memory, crime and exploitation, while McGee's pursuit occasionally comes close enough to threaten the identity David has spent years protecting.

s03e01.description: David befriends a troubled rock star whose career and mental health are being controlled by her domineering manager and sister.

s03e02.description: A toxic military canister blinds a young officer and then David himself, forcing him to investigate a hazardous cover-up without his sight.

s03e03.description: David meets a gifted teenage runaway and helps her search for the mother who abandoned her rather than remain a laboratory subject.

s03e04.description: Arrested for vagrancy, David is sent to a corrupt work camp where prisoners are exploited as forced labor for local interests.

s03e05.description: An eccentric aging magician recruits David as his assistant for a comeback performance whose old rivalries make the tricks genuinely dangerous.

s03e06.description: Working as a rodeo medic, David learns that the show's biggest star is hiding an illness that could kill him if he keeps competing.

s03e07.description: David drives for a struggling taxi company targeted by criminals who want control of the business for a drug-smuggling operation.

s03e08.description: David secretly returns home for Thanksgiving, confronting his estranged father and sister while a crop disaster threatens the family community.

s03e09.description: A private-plane trip strands David on an island with a wealthy hunter who discovers the Hulk and decides he has found the ultimate prey.

s03e10.description: David works at a New Orleans clinic and helps a young doctor challenge a fraudulent voodoo healer exploiting the local community.

s03e11.description: A department-store robbery traps David and his coworkers overnight, forcing him to infiltrate the thieves' plan from inside.

s03e12.description: David is mistaken for a wanted criminal who recognizes the resemblance and deliberately uses it to divert police attention.

s03e13.description: McGee's new publisher threatens to end the Register's Hulk coverage, driving him to prove the creature exists without David ever appearing openly.

s03e14.description: David becomes stage manager for a carnival act and tries to protect a young psychic blamed whenever misfortune strikes the troupe.

s03e15.description: A motorcycle ride pulls David into a conflict involving a fugitive biker, the police and the club he abandoned.

s03e16.description: David discovers that girls in a residential home are being trained as pickpockets and safecrackers rather than being protected.

s03e17.description: David wins a large lottery prize but cannot safely claim it in his own name, entrusting the ticket to a man with a criminal past.

s03e18.description: A genuine psychic sees the Hulk inside David and also foresees McGee's murder, forcing David to act without exposing himself.

s03e19.description: David is caught between federal agents and a violent gang and must convincingly play both informant and criminal to survive.

s03e20.description: A masked killer terrorizes a college town and suspicion falls on David, leaving him trapped between police interrogation and an angry mob.

s03e21.description: A masquerade on a private island gives McGee a rare opportunity to corner the Hulk while David is trapped among wealthy party guests.

s03e22.description: David races against a nine-hour deadline to keep hit men from killing a young patient and a former gangster.

s03e23.description: David walks into a major forest fire and is accused of starting it, while McGee joins the firefighting effort hoping for another Hulk sighting.
